qualification.education_qualification: Postgraduate Degree in Chemistry, Bachelor's/ Master's Degree in Petroleum Engineering or Business Economics
qualification.details: Deputy Chief Chemist: Postgraduate Degree in Chemistry of minimum 02 years' duration with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade and must have studied Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics at the graduation level; AND Minimum 09 years of Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience. Deputy Chief Engineer (Reservoir): Bachelor's Degree in Petroleum Engineering of minimum 04 years' duration with minimum 65% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade; AND Minimum 09 years of Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience OR Master's Degree in Petroleum Engineering or Petroleum Technology of minimum 02 years' duration with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade along with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering in any discipline of minimum 04 years' duration; AND Minimum 09 years of Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience. Economist: Postgraduate Degree in Economics or Business Economics with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade; AND Minimum Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience (09 years for Grade D, 13 years for Grade E, 17 years for Grade F).

content_sections.heading: Oil India Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Deputy Chief Chemist, 1 for Deputy Chief Engineer (Reservoir), and 1 for Economist.

content_sections.heading: Oil India Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Deputy Chief Chemist: Postgraduate Degree in Chemistry of minimum 02 years' duration with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade and must have studied Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics at the graduation level; AND Minimum 09 years of Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience. Deputy Chief Engineer (Reservoir): Bachelor's Degree in Petroleum Engineering of minimum 04 years' duration with minimum 65% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade; AND Minimum 09 years of Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience OR Master's Degree in Petroleum Engineering or Petroleum Technology of minimum 02 years' duration with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade along with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering in any discipline of minimum 04 years' duration; AND Minimum 09 years of Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience. Economist: Postgraduate Degree in Economics or Business Economics with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/ Grade; AND Minimum Post Qualification Relevant Work Experience (09 years for Grade D, 13 years for Grade E, 17 years for Grade F).

content_sections.heading: Oil India Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 49 years for all posts. Age relaxation: 5 years for Ex-Servicemen, PwBD as per GoI, 3 years for PhD, internal candidates up to 54 years. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Oil India Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Deputy Chief Chemist / Deputy Chief Engineer (Reservoir): ₹ 90000-240000 Per Month Economist: ₹ 90000-240000 (Grade D) / ₹ 100000-260000 (Grade E/ F) Per Month

content_sections.heading: Oil India Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Personal Interview (PI) Document Verification Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Oil India Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Oil India to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Oil India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Oil India Recruitment 2026 is 10th October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this Oil India recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Deputy Chief Chemist, Deputy Chief Engineer (Reservoir), and Economist in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Economist post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Economist post is a Postgraduate Degree in Economics or Business Economics with a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/Grade.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for Oil India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this recruitment is 49 years.

faq.question: Q6. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Deputy Chief Chemist, Deputy Chief Engineer (Reservoir), and Economist.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these Oil India jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Personal Interview (PI), Document Verification, and a Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 90,000 to Rs. 2,60,000 per month, depending on the specific post and grade.

faq.question: Q9. What is the starting date for the online application?
faq.answer: The online application process for Oil India Recruitment 2026 begins on 11th September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is usually provided in the "Important Links" section of the job advertisement or on the official website of Oil India.
